itinerary: Board the AC Volvo at Majnu ka Tilla at 7:30 PM. Overnight journey via Chandigarh and Mandi with a dinner halt at Murthal.
Reach Manali by 9 AM and check in. Afternoon at Solang Valley (paragliding and ropeway at own cost). Evening walk through Old Manali's cafés.
Visit Hadimba Devi Temple, Vashisht hot springs and Mall Road. Board the return Volvo at 5 PM; reach Delhi early next morning.
Leave Delhi at 5:30 AM and reach the Shivpuri camp by noon. Lunch, beach volleyball, then a bonfire with music and dinner by the Ganga.
Breakfast, then 16 km of white-water rafting from Shivpuri to Rishikesh. Laxman Jhula, Triveni Ghat evening aarti, and back in Delhi by 11 PM.
Board at 6:30 PM for the overnight drive into the Parvati Valley.
Taxi to Barshaini and a 12 km trek through pine forest to Kheerganga. Soak in the hot spring and camp under the stars.
Trek down after breakfast, stop at Manikaran Sahib, and board the evening Volvo to Delhi.
Board the AC sleeper at 6 PM for the overnight run to the City of Lakes.
Check in to the haveli, explore City Palace, take a sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola and watch the Bagore ki Haveli folk dance show.
Morning at Saheliyon ki Bari and Fateh Sagar Lake, shopping at Hathi Pol, and the evening bus back to Delhi.
Early departure, breakfast stop at Murthal, reach Shimla by afternoon. Walk the Ridge, Christ Church and Mall Road.
Morning excursion to Kufri and Green Valley viewpoints, then head back to Delhi by night.
Reach Varanasi by noon, darshan at Kashi Vishwanath, and the grand Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat.
Dawn boat ride along the ghats, breakfast, a visit to Sarnath, and back to Lucknow by evening.
Reach the resort by lunch. Pool time, an evening nature walk along the Kosi river, and a bonfire dinner.
Early morning jeep safari in the Jhirna zone, breakfast, a stop at Corbett Falls, and back to Delhi by night.
Board at Dadar at 7 PM for the coastal overnight drive.
Check in, then Baga, Calangute and Fort Aguada. Evening free for the shacks.
Basilica of Bom Jesus, Se Cathedral, Panjim's Latin Quarter and a sunset Mandovi river cruise.
Anjuna flea market and Vagator cliffs, then the evening bus back to Mumbai.
Drive via Dehradun, stop at Kempty Falls, and spend the evening on Mall Road.
Gun Hill ropeway, Company Garden, a café breakfast, and back to Delhi by night.
Long scenic drive via Rishikesh and Rudraprayag.
16 km trek (pony or palki at own cost) to Kedarnath; evening aarti at the temple.
Early morning darshan, then trek back down to Gaurikund and drive to Guptkashi.
Drive back to Delhi, reaching by late night.
A dramatic drive along the Sutlej to the Sangla valley.
Day trip to Chitkul near the Tibet border, then Kamru Fort.
Drive back to Shimla and board the overnight Volvo to Delhi.
Reach by noon. Amber Fort, Panna Meena ka Kund, and a Rajasthani dinner at Chokhi Dhani.
Hawa Mahal, City Palace, Jantar Mantar and shopping at Johari Bazaar, then back to Delhi.
Board at 8 PM; reach McLeodganj by morning.
Dalai Lama Temple, Bhagsu waterfall and Tibetan cafés.
HPCA cricket stadium, Norbulingka Institute, and the evening Volvo back.
Board at 6 PM; reach Manali by morning.
Drive through the Atal Tunnel to the Sissu snow point (cab at own cost); Club House in the evening.
Hadimba Temple, Tibetan monastery, Mall Road, and the evening Volvo back.
Solang Valley and the Atal Tunnel north portal.
Drive to the Parvati Valley, visit Manikaran Sahib, and spend the evening by the river in Kasol.
Chalal village walk, then the evening Volvo to Delhi.
Reach Pushkar, camel safari and a folk night.
Brahma Temple and the lake ghats, then back to Delhi.
Board at 7 PM for South Goa.
Jeep safari to Dudhsagar Falls and lunch at a spice plantation.
Palolem beach and Colva sunset, then the night bus back.
